doc: The game's crafting stations: the workbench, the production stations and the crafters' stations of the villagers. A recipe names its station (recipes.station), so a station's recipes are the recipes that name it.

ids.rule: A station has the id of the item that builds or offers it (the workbench is game:craftingstation_workbench, the forge game:prop_production_t1_forge, the blacksmith game:npc_crafter_blacksmith01). A station without an item is game:station_<its 32-bit station id as 8 hex digits>. When two stations would get the same id, the one that held it first keeps it and the other is <id>~<first 8 hex digits of its GUID>.

item.doc: The item that builds the station (a villager's station: the villager's item); absent for the stations of the flame altar and a few others without one.

npc.doc: The station is a villager's (a crafter or a trader), not one the player builds.
